sentences.en: When cowardice is conducive to self-preservation, it is called intelligence.
sentences.zh: 当胆怯有助于自保时，它被称为明智。

sentences.en: Your behavior is not conducive to the desired environment.
sentences.zh: 你的行为不利于营造期望的环境。

sentences.en: Soft music is often conducive to sleep.
sentences.zh: 轻柔的音乐常常有助于睡眠。
